# Author: Cameron McGhee

  library(tidyverse)
  library(boot)
  library(scales)

box_path <- "NBA2024.csv"
def_path <- "team_def_rating_2024.csv"

box <- read_csv(box_path, show_col_types = FALSE)
def <- read_csv(def_path, show_col_types = FALSE)


league_def_avg <- def$opp_def_rating %>% mean(na.rm = TRUE)

box <- box %>%
  left_join(def, by = "opponent") %>%
  mutate(
    MissedFG = pmax(FGA - FGM, 0),
    OppEffAdj = league_def_avg / opp_def_rating
  )


compute_poss_used <- function(df) {
  df %>% mutate(
    Poss_used = FGA + 0.44*FTA + TOV + 0.2*AST + 0.5*OREB + 0.5*(STL + BLK),
    Poss_used = if_else(Poss_used <= 0, NA_real_, Poss_used)
  )
}

compute_IER <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    compute_poss_used() %>%
    mutate(
      IER_raw = (PTS + 1.5*AST + 1.2*OREB + 1.3*STL + 1.5*BLK - 1.2*TOV - 0.8*MissedFG - 0.5*PF) / Poss_used,
      IER = IER_raw * OppEffAdj
    )
}

ier_df <- compute_IER(box)


boot_IER_player <- function(player_row, R = 1000) {

  set.seed(42)
  comps <- c("PTS","AST","OREB","STL","BLK","TOV","MissedFG","PF","FGA","FTA")
  vals  <- as.numeric(player_row[comps])
  names(vals) <- comps
  OppEffAdj <- as.numeric(player_row["OppEffAdj"])
  if (any(is.na(vals)) || is.na(OppEffAdj)) return(c(NA, NA, NA))

  sim_IER <- numeric(R)
  for (r in seq_len(R)) {
    sim <- rpois(length(vals), lambda = pmax(vals, 0))
    names(sim) <- comps
    Poss_used <- sim["FGA"] + 0.44*sim["FTA"] + sim["TOV"] + 0.2*sim["AST"] + 0.5*sim["OREB"] + 0.5*(sim["STL"] + sim["BLK"])
    if (Poss_used <= 0) {
      sim_IER[r] <- NA_real_
    } else {
      IER_raw <- (sim["PTS"] + 1.5*sim["AST"] + 1.2*sim["OREB"] + 1.3*sim["STL"] + 1.5*sim["BLK"] - 1.2*sim["TOV"] - 0.8*sim["MissedFG"] - 0.5*sim["PF"]) / Poss_used
      sim_IER[r] <- IER_raw * OppEffAdj
    }
  }
  c(mean = mean(sim_IER, na.rm = TRUE),
    lo = quantile(sim_IER, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
    hi = quantile(sim_IER, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE))
}

boot_res <- ier_df %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    IER_boot_stats = list(boot_IER_player(cur_data()))
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    IER_boot_mean = map_dbl(IER_boot_stats, 1),
    IER_boot_lo   = map_dbl(IER_boot_stats, 2),
    IER_boot_hi   = map_dbl(IER_boot_stats, 3)
  ) %>%
  select(-IER_boot_stats)


cor_results <- list()
if (all(c("PER","WS48") %in% names(boot_res))) {
  cor_results$IER_PER  <- cor(boot_res$IER,  boot_res$PER,  use = "complete.obs")
  cor_results$IER_WS48 <- cor(boot_res$IER,  boot_res$WS48, use = "complete.obs")
} else if ("PER" %in% names(boot_res)) {
  cor_results$IER_PER  <- cor(boot_res$IER,  boot_res$PER,  use = "complete.obs")
}
print(cor_results)


# Figure 1: PER vs IER
if ("PER" %in% names(boot_res)) {
  p1 <- ggplot(boot_res, aes(x = PER, y = IER, label = player)) +
    geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
    geom_text(nudge_y = 0.02, size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
    labs(title = "Comparing IER and PER",
         x = "Player Efficiency Rating (PER)",
         y = "Impact Efficiency Rating (IER)") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
}
p1

# Figure 2: Top players by IER with 95% CI
top_n <- 10
p2 <- boot_res %>%
  arrange(desc(IER)) %>%
  slice_head(n = top_n) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = reorder(player, IER), y = IER)) +
  geom_col(alpha = 0.9) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = IER_boot_lo, ymax = IER_boot_hi), width = 0.2) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(title = "Top Players by Impact Efficiency Rating (IER)",
       x = "Player",
       y = "IER (with 95% bootstrap CI)") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

p2
